humanFeedback.text: Right it is. Can you do a similar treatment to the cork oak
humanFeedback.holmApproval: Right-hand 50/50 realistic/brighter material with hierarchical normal weights .45/.40/.15; approval of isolated study treatment only

implementation.scope: Cork-oak hero material and shading only
implementation.normals: Three normalized sources in hero-local space: 3D crown bounds, bounds of each existing terminal spray group, original transformed card normal. Weights .45/.40/.15.
implementation.material: 50% existing physically lit texture color plus50% warm painterly pigment field driven by the actual directional key
implementation.bark: Modest pigment lift and reduced bump strength, original generated cork texture retained

review.result: Clearer olive foliage and bark; much less muddy than original. Sparse tufted crown and some pale tips remain.
